story: Why Do DMT Users See Insects from a Parallel Universe?
text: [VIDEO] ^My favorite way I've seen it described, and also a really cool video even without the subtext. (but ya this is one rabbit hole that I've yet to travel down. guess i took the blue pill, but more pills just seemed unnecessary at the time)

If you liked this video, also check out this one: Inner Life of the Cell [LINK] And here's a nice TED talk by Drew Berry: Animations of unseeable biology [VIDEO] These kind of visualizations are of course an idealized view on how it works. As others have already mentioned, the processes are hugely chaotic and much more probabilistic than deterministic. On this scale everything is just one huge wobbling soup of things crashing into each other, which makes it even more fascinating that it works as well as it does.
